meta.title: Al Nashamah — Fresh Sheep & Goats Delivered in the UAE
meta.description: Order fresh sheep and goats online in the UAE — Naeemi, Najdi, Herri, Somali, Local and Kashmiri. Slaughtered, cut and packed your way, delivered to your door.

home.heroTitle: Heritage of the local market, with modern trading standards
home.heroText: Choose your sheep or goat, pick the age and weight, the cutting and packaging — we handle the rest and deliver fresh to your door.

steps.title: Choose
steps.text: Pick the breed, age and weight that suit your occasion.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Select how you want it cut — whole, halves or pieces.

steps.title: Pack
steps.text: Slaughterhouse bag, carton box, or foam box with ice.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: Fresh to your door, on the day and time you choose.

trust.title: Clear age & weight
trust.text: You know exactly what you are getting.

trust.title: Fresh delivery
trust.text: Packed with care, delivered across the UAE.

faq.q: Which areas do you deliver to?
faq.a: We deliver across the UAE. Delivery fees and time slots will be announced soon.

faq.q: Can I choose how the meat is cut?
faq.a: Yes. After choosing the breed and size you select the cutting style and packaging.
Yes. Every animal is slaughtered according to Islamic rites in a licensed slaughterhouse.

faq.q: Do I need an account to order?
faq.a: No. You can sign in with your mobile number or continue as a guest.

dashboard.ordersSoon: Orders will appear here once online ordering is switched on (Phase 5).

breeds.title: Breeds & stock
breeds.help: Two switches per breed: “In stock / Out of stock” keeps the breed on the website with an “Out of stock” label; “Shown / Hidden” removes it from the website completely. Sizes have their own stock switch. Changes appear immediately.
breeds.sizesHelp: Usually 3 sizes; add a 4th or 5th when needed. Weight is after slaughter.

categories.title: Categories
categories.sacrificeMinAgeHelp: Sizes younger than this can't be ordered as an Udhiyah or Aqiqah (e.g. sheep 6, goats 12). Leave empty for no rule.

seasonal.title: Seasonal offers
seasonal.occasionHelp: Customers coming from this offer get this occasion pre-selected.
seasonal.noExtras: “Order includes” not available for these orders (e.g. Eid slaughterhouse rules)

simple.cuttingHelp: The final list will be confirmed by the owner. These are shown when ordering (Phase 3).
simple.extrasHelp: Checkboxes on each order, e.g. head, intestines, tripe.
simple.unavailableNoteEn: Message to customers when switched off (English)
simple.unavailableNoteAr: Message to customers when switched off (Arabic)
simple.unavailableNoteHelp: Customers see this instead of "Out of stock", e.g. "Not available during Eid due to government slaughterhouse regulations". Empty = "Not available at the moment".

settings.title: Business settings
settings.help: Used on invoices and contact buttons. Leave empty until you have the details.

staff.title: Staff
staff.name: Name
staff.roleHelp: Owner: everything. Manager: everything except staff. Order staff: stock switches. Content editor: names, descriptions and photos.
staff.created: Account created. Give this temporary password to the person — it is shown only once:

audit.title: Activity log
audit.help: The latest 200 changes made in the admin panel.

account.title: My account
account.rules: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.

texts.title: Website text
texts.help: Change any wording on the website, in English and Arabic. Each box starts with the current text — edit it and press Save. To go back to the original wording, empty the box and save.

branding.title: Branding
branding.help: Replace the logo and the picture in the green welcome section. Remove an upload to go back to the original.
branding.logo: Logo (light backgrounds — top of every page)
branding.logoHelp: Transparent PNG or SVG, wide, about 1300 × 460 px.
branding.logoReverseHelp: Light-coloured version, transparent PNG or SVG, about 1300 × 460 px.
branding.hero: Picture in the green welcome section
branding.heroHelp: Transparent PNG or SVG works best on green, about 900 × 470 px.
branding.whatsappNote: The WhatsApp number is set in Business settings.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.help: Promotions slide at the top of the home page, above the green welcome section. Only promotions that are switched on (and within their dates) are shown; with none, the slider disappears.
promotions.imageHelp: Best: 1920 × 640 px (3:1). On phones the middle part is shown, so keep important text in the centre.
promotions.imageMobileHelp: Best: 1080 × 810 px (4:3). If empty, the wide picture is used.
promotions.linkHelp: A page on this site such as /ar/sheep/naeemi, or a full https:// address.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.zonesHelp: Leave the fee empty while it isn't decided — customers then see “Delivery fee will be confirmed”.
delivery.slotsHelp: Customers choose a date and one of these times. Orders close the set number of hours before the start.
delivery.blackoutsHelp: Customers can't choose these dates (e.g. a public holiday).
delivery.pickupEnabled: Customers can choose to pick up from the shop
